estimate_basis: Linear scaling from recorded Dev13 GPT-5.1 usage, with Test40 reference-answer L1.5 used directly for the L1.5 unit cost

components.stage: Hybrid and BGE local retrieval plus L1
Common soft tagger for three systems
Matched RAG answer generation for three systems
L3 three complete repeats for three systems

notes: The L3 upper estimate scales the completed Dev13 three-repeat cost by call count and is conservative because Test40 has fewer claim groups per question on average.
The ceiling includes a modest allowance for schema failures or manually resumed transient failures.
No paid call is authorized by this estimate or by the preflight package.
